headline: [El Niño Strikes!] Floods Hit Peru and Ecuador, [34 Dead] in Ecuador
caption:
🌊 El Niño Strikes! Floods Hit Peru and Ecuador, 34 Dead in Ecuador

Heavy rains linked to a very strong El Niño flooded cities in Peru and Ecuador on Friday. In Piura, northern Peru, water rose to waist height in the streets after 12 hours of heavy rain, AFP reported. Ecuador's risk management agency said 34 people have died and 47,000 have been affected across the country.

🔹 About 2,000 families were affected in Piura, according to preliminary reports from Peru's civil defence chief. Flooding forced patients at a Piura hospital to move to its auditorium.
🔹 In Manta, Ecuador, two rivers broke their banks and residents waded through chest-deep water.
🔹 Peru's President Keiko Fujimori postponed a trip to Colombia because of the crisis. Peru's weather service warned more heavy rain could fall over the next four days.
